notes: Every (…) or […] placeholder in the RFQ template is a user-defined field. Fields are discovered from the template itself, so adding a new placeholder to the Word file adds a new field; this file only says what a field means.
scope: project = one value for every RFQ of the BOQ; package = one value per work package; supplier = one value per RFQ letter (one letter per supplier).

detect: what the agent may auto-fill. 'wp_name' = the work-package name produced by the packaging step; 'project_name' / 'project_location' / 'owner' = read from the BOQ header (only with an explicit label, verbatim, cross-checked); 'same_as:<Field>' = copies another field. Auto-filled values always need the user's approval.
Field names are matched case-insensitively; unknown fields default to scope 'project' with no detection (the user types them).
